member.summary: How often the background pruning loop wakes to close idle and expired connections. Default: 60 seconds.

member.name: M:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.RateLimitingMiddleware.InvokeAsync(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext)
member.summary: Checks rate limit before allowing request to proceed. Returns 429 Too Many Requests if limit exceeded. Key is based on tenant ID or IP address (tenant ID preferred).

member.name: T:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.RateLimitingOptions
member.summary: Configuration options for rate limiting behavior. Allows tuning limits without recompiling code.

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.RateLimitingOptions.RequestsPerMinute
member.summary: Number of requests allowed per minute (default: 300 = 5 req/sec). Adjust based on expected load and infrastructure capacity.

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.RateLimitingOptions.BurstCapacity
member.summary: Burst capacity: how many requests over limit before blocking. Allows handling traffic spikes gracefully.

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.RateLimitingOptions.CleanupIntervalSeconds
member.summary: Cleanup interval: how often to remove unused buckets from memory. Prevents memory bloat from inactive clients.

member.name: T:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.TokenBucket
member.summary: Token bucket implementation for rate limiting. Thread-safe using lock for concurrent access patterns. Tracks last refill time to implement sliding window accurately.

member.name: M:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.TokenBucket.TryConsumeToken
member.summary: Attempts to consume one token from the bucket. Refills bucket based on elapsed time since last refill. Returns true if token available, false if limit exceeded.

member.name: M:SqliteMultiTenant.Middleware.TokenBucket.RefillTokens
member.summary: Refills bucket proportional to elapsed time. Example: 5 req/sec for 2 seconds = +10 tokens. Capped at bucket capacity to prevent overflow.

member.name: T:SqliteMultiTenant.Services.TenantDatabaseMaintenanceOptions
member.summary: Configuration options for tenant database maintenance operations. Controls which maintenance operations are enabled and their behavior.

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Services.TenantDatabaseMaintenanceOptions.EnableVacuum
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable VACUUM operation to reclaim disk space. VACUUM rebuilds the database file, repacking it into a minimal amount of disk space. Default: true (recommended for production to prevent database bloat).

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Services.TenantDatabaseMaintenanceOptions.EnableAnalyze
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable ANALYZE operation to update query statistics. ANALYZE collects statistics about tables and indexes and stores them in the sqlite_stat1 table, which improves the SQLite query planner's performance. Default: true (recommended for production to maintain optimal query performance).

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Services.TenantDatabaseMaintenanceOptions.EnableOptimize
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to enable PRAGMA optimize operation to update database statistics. PRAGMA optimize runs ANALYZE and other database optimizations automatically. Default: true (recommended for production to ensure regular database optimization).

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Services.TenantDatabaseMaintenanceOptions.IntervalHours
member.summary: Gets or sets the maintenance interval in hours. Specifies how often maintenance operations should be executed on each tenant database. Default: 24 (daily maintenance cycle). Minimum: 1 (hourly maintenance).
member.exception: Thrown when value is less than 1.

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Services.TenantDatabaseMaintenanceOptions.TimeoutSeconds
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum time allowed for maintenance on a single database, in seconds. This timeout applies to each individual maintenance operation (VACUUM, ANALYZE, PRAGMA optimize). Default: 300 (5 minutes per database operation). Minimum: 30 (30 seconds minimum to allow for small databases).
member.exception: Thrown when value is less than 30.

member.name: P:SqliteMultiTenant.Services.TenantDatabaseMaintenanceOptions.DegreeOfParallelism
member.summary: Gets or sets the parallelism level for maintenance operations. A value of 0 runs operations sequentially. A value greater than 1 enables parallel execution. Note: Parallel execution may increase resource utilization and should be used cautiously in production. Default: 1 (sequential execution).
member.exception: Thrown when value is less than 0.
